# CUI // SP-CTI

# floci — the AWS API emulator (flx project). Bundle it for the high side with:
#     python tools/airgap/image_vendor.py --save --topic floci --json
#
# A DIGEST, NEVER A TAG. `floci/floci:2.0.1` is refused by parse_pin: a tag is
# mutable, so a bundle built from one cannot be shown to contain what was
# intended.
#
# PROVENANCE OF THIS DIGEST, and it is not this card's measurement: it was
# measured against Docker Hub on 2026-09-05 by flx-ci-01 and is declared in
# `args/floci_iac_gate.yaml::image_digest` (floci/floci:2.0.1, published
# 2026-09-01). `tests/airgap/test_image_vendor.py::test_the_floci_pin_agrees_
# with_the_measured_digest` asserts the two files still agree, so ONE measured
# fact cannot come to be spelled two ways.
#
# NOT the `-compat` variant: it adds Python 3, the AWS CLI and boto3, is a
# larger image, and changes nothing about the API surface — `/_localstack/health`
# is served by the plain image.
#
# This host's local cache did NOT hold the image when the vendor was built
# (verified 2026-09-05), so `--save` here reports `absent_from_local_cache` and
# exits non-zero rather than pulling. That is the designed refusal, not a defect:
# pull it on a connected host first, then vendor.
